title: TACTIQL and FULCRUM deep dossier enrichment

selectedGap.reason: The owner selected TACTIQL for a source-prioritized deep dossier and FULCRUM capability enrichment with targeted LinkedIn announcement discovery.

guardrailNotes: This is a private review candidate and cannot accept, publish or write canonical ecosystem records.
LinkedIn announcements remain discovery-only unless resolved to durable government, partner or independent sources.
All existing Mission Area and Public Need relationships are preserved unchanged; no new match is proposed.
KILO, FULCRUM and DJINN are not treated as interchangeable without explicit public evidence.

candidates.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: TACTIQL's FULCRUM capability is updated to include Digital Motion Imagery, Cursor-on-Target and Variable Message Format translation, Canadian Army KILO validation, NATO exercise maturity and the dated DJINN current activity. Evidence: 24 durable sources from ised-isde.canada.ca, canadabuys.canada.ca, NATO DIANA, DVIDS, Canadian Army Today, Ottawa Business Journal, MassChallenge and current TACTIQL product pages support the proposed fields. Mission/Public Need read: Existing Mission Area and Public Need relationships remain unchanged; Edge Data Processing is the strongest premise because FULCRUM conditions and translates ISR video and metadata at the sensor-to-command data boundary, while Arctic Domain Awareness remains a bounded remote-environment connection. Unknowns: DJINN technical scope, KILO-to-FULCRUM configuration continuity, standards conformance, security accreditation, commercial configurations, customer acceptance, fielding, ownership and current headcount remain unresolved. Reviewer action: Review the FULCRUM capability, current activity, program participation, funding event and organization relationship operations against the KILO validation, 2026-08-21 DJINN amendment and non-deployment limits before accepting this amber refresh.
reviewWarnings: ISED anchors operational validation to KILO, while FULCRUM is the current product; no first-party migration record proves that every validated KILO configuration is equivalent to current FULCRUM.

The NATO DIANA TACTIQL spotlight is explicitly written by TACTIQL. TRL 9, product-market fit, sales and NSPA or NCIA procurement-route claims remain company-authored and are not independently promoted as fact.
CanadaBuys discloses DJINN's title, value, dates and parties but not technical scope, deliverables, acceptance or deployment. The candidate does not assign DJINN to FULCRUM.
Later Testing Stream contracts CW2430527 and CW2439940 disclose values and dates but not sufficient product scope; contract values are not combined as revenue, spend or proof of outcomes.

No public conformance certificate, interface-control document, throughput or latency benchmark, security accreditation, classification level, supported-hardware list, pricing, licence terms or lead time was found.
Exercise and programme records establish participation and demonstrations, not operational fielding, procurement, universal performance or customer acceptance.
Calian and Kongsberg materials describe partnerships and forward-looking integration goals, not completed joint systems, customer contracts or delivered operational capability.

LinkedIn surfaced current release testing, a General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada Battle Lab exploration and an NRC IRAP Defence Industry Assist claim; no sufficient durable source resolved these into candidate fields.
Public sources do not establish current shareholders, ownership percentages, ultimate beneficial ownership, current headcount, production capacity or a complete facility footprint.

organization.name: TACTIQL
organization.description: TACTIQL is a Canadian veteran-founded defence data-assurance company building FULCRUM, a tactical-edge platform that verifies, conditions, enriches, and standardizes ISR video and metadata from crewed and uncrewed sensors.

profile_data.currentActivity: TACTIQL progressed its earlier KILO capability into FULCRUM, completed Canadian government testing, entered NATO DIANA Phase 2, and announced a Calian defence co-development partnership.
profile_data.evidenceBoundary: Identity, capability, location, activity, and relationship facts are source-backed. Mission matches are labelled derived analyst cues and are not procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest, or classified demand.

organization.operating_context: TACTIQL is a Canadian veteran-founded defence data-assurance company building FULCRUM, a tactical-edge platform that verifies, conditions, enriches, and standardizes ISR video and metadata from crewed and uncrewed sensors. Its published capability portfolio includes FULCRUM.
organization.canadian_footprint: TACTIQL has a documented Canadian operating presence in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada. Its public organization and capability evidence should be read at that location and national scope only where the cited sources explicitly support it.

reviewed_questions.context: TACTIQL's public evidence establishes its current role and offering, but it does not answer every access, configuration, eligibility, maturity or buyer question needed for a first business-development conversation.
reviewed_questions.question: Which FULCRUM configurations are commercially available now, what integration or qualification work is required, and which public customer or deployment evidence can be shared?

capabilities.name: FULCRUM
capabilities.summary: FULCRUM verifies and processes ISR feeds, corrects geospatial errors, enriches full-motion-video metadata, standardizes outputs for interoperability, optimizes network delivery, and deploys from soldier-portable devices to servers and secure cloud environments.

missionMatches.alignmentSummary: TACTIQL may support Arctic domain awareness by helping operators integrate, protect, interpret, communicate, or rehearse decisions from distributed public-source sensor and mission data in remote environments.
TACTIQL may support autonomous patrol and monitoring by improving the ingestion, assurance, fusion, analysis, or communication of data from crewed and uncrewed sensing platforms.
TACTIQL may support edge data processing through cited deployable compute, data conditioning, inference, visualization, communications, or training workflows used close to operational users.

relationships.publicSummary: Calian publicly announced a partnership with TACTIQL to co-develop and commercialize a sovereign ISR solution using complementary defence and data-assurance capabilities.
